data.name: SSC CGL Tier-I 2026
data.fullName: SSC CGL — Staff Selection Commission Combined Graduate Level Examination (2026)
data.description: The SSC Combined Graduate Level (CGL) Exam is a national-level recruitment examination conducted by the Government of India’s Staff Selection Commission for Group B and Group C posts in ministries, departments, and organisations. It tests candidates’ proficiency across reasoning, quantitative aptitude, English, and general awareness, and serves as a gateway to stable central government jobs.
data.eligibility:
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
• Age Limit: Generally 18–32 years (post-specific age relaxations apply as per government norms).

Tier-I Syllabus Areas:.section: Quant: Arithmetic, Algebra, Geometry, Data Interpretation
General Awareness: Current Affairs, History, Geography, Polity, Economy

data.conductingBody: Staff Selection Commission (SSC), Government of India
data.vacancies: To be notified in the official SSC CGL 2026 notification. Historically the CGL cycle fills ~14,500+ posts, but the exact figure for 2026 will be released by SSC.
data.salaryRange: Based on 7th Pay Commission, typical CGL posts pay between ₹25,500 – ₹1,51,100+ depending on the post and pay level.
